name: Kernel
description: Runs cloud Chromium browsers for AI agents, with stealth, proxies, managed auth and replays, driven by Playwright, CDP, the REST API, CLI or hosted MCP.

skills.name: Manage Browsers
skills.description: Creates, lists, gets and deletes cloud browser sessions, with headless, stealth, profile, proxy and viewport options.

skills.name: Execute Playwright Code
skills.description: Runs Playwright TypeScript code against a Kernel browser session to automate clicks, form fills and page reads.

skills.name: Computer Action
skills.description: Sends mouse, keyboard and screenshot controls to a browser session, for computer-use agents that act on pixels.

skills.name: Manage Profiles
skills.description: Saves and reuses browser profiles with cookies and logins, so agents stay signed in to sites across sessions.

skills.name: Manage Replays
skills.description: Starts, stops and lists video replay recordings of a browser session, for reviewing and debugging agent runs.
